Mistral Agents code interpreter timeout exceeded

item.text:
Yes. Mistral’s Code Interpreter executions have a timeout limit, although the current Code Interpreter documentation does not specify its duration. If the code exceeds the limit, the execution is terminated and reported as timed out/failed; no completed output is returned.

See the [Code Interpreter documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/code_interpreter), which documents execution metadata including `completed_at` and `code_output`.
